title: NeonPay
tagline: A simple experience to use solana pay on top of neon evm. You can send tokens from neonevm to solana.
description: Solana pay has a great user experience, it is pretty simple for merchants to use it and now it is integreated into shopify and many other apps, so why dont to use your neon evm tokens to pay with solana pay easily? that is why we created neon pay. Use the great UX from solana now in your newon evm wallet.
how_its_made: By simple using the transfer tokens from neon evm to solana, we read the solana pay qr code, extract the data and then send the tokens from neon evm to solana. We have a little dapp where you can scan the QR code, and then using neon evm sdk to transfer tokens, we transfer directly to the solana pay address.
